{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= GUI

|descr= Movie credits function.

|exec= spawn

|s1= [display, mode] call [[BIS_fnc_credits_movie]]

|p1= display: [[Display]] - (Optional) display to use to show the credits

|p2= mode: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 0) 0 to start the credits, 1 to end them

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>[] spawn BIS_fnc_credits_movie;</sqf>

|x2= Display the credits full screen:
<sqf>
[] spawn {
	disableSerialization;
	// create credits
	(findDisplay 46) createDisplay "RscCredits";
	[] call BIS_fnc_credits_movie;
};
</sqf>

|seealso= [[BIS_fnc_credits]] [[BIS_fnc_credits_movieConfig]] [[BIS_fnc_credits_movieSupport]]
}}
